approval.note: One whole LP native quotation independently recalculated from integer invariant, rates, balances and fees. Existing-holder 0.01 LP withdrawal eth_call matches its own native quote exactly, quote+1 raw unit reverts. No transaction broadcast. Not a solvency or issuer-risk audit.

valuation.methodology: Native single-coin withdrawal quotation at a pinned block, applying each stage and its fees. Current code, coin identity, decimals, supply, cash and available pause/blacklist checks are repeated before LIVE.
limitations: One-LP native quotation; not a market price, full-supply NAV, investment recommendation or guaranteed execution.
Pool operation is reviewed; liquidity can be small and currency issuer/security risks remain.
No stablecoin parity assumption: the final asset is the configured USDT token.
Execution simulation used 0.01 LP from an existing holder; the displayed 1 LP quote was separately recalculated with integer arithmetic. Pool liquidity is small (~2,075 USD in discovery metadata).
